prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep blue-to-grey input wire and amber-to-grey-to-purple output wires unchanged. Keep case, lid circuit, text "AI Toolkit" / "for Fractal", background and all other elements unchanged.

Precise local edit of ONLY four short white wires in lower tray logo. Do not change ANY tile, case, text, shape or colour. Incoming wires to parallel tiles must enter their LEFT SIDE midpoint, never top or bottom. In this 1254x1254 source image, exact endpoints approximately: upstream grey right edge (492,574); upper parallel left edge (515,520), upper parallel right edge (577,520); lower parallel left edge (508,623), lower parallel right edge (573,623); downstream amber left edge (627,574). Draw four separate smooth thin curved lines: 492,574 -> 515,520; 492,574 -> 508,623; 577,520 -> 627,574; 573,623 -> 627,574. For each branch approach its LEFT edge with a short HORIZONTAL segment, so wire visibly enters SIDE of tile, NOT the underside of upper tile or top of lower tile. Each output leaves branch right edge horizontally. Remove the wrong incoming upper wire ending underneath upper tile around 540,535 and wrong incoming lower wire ending on top of lower tile around 540,608. Cables should bend in the narrow gaps to the left and right of the parallel tiles, NOT extend into the tile faces. They may be smooth S bends. Each branch tile has one inlet halfway down its left edge and one outlet halfway down its right edge. Preserve the exact entire image except these four wires.
